interfaces.output_schema: Observed receipt/effect/artifact fields in expect; unavailable required tools/targets are nonpassing.

implementation_steps: Generate timestamped source/test/coverage/conformance/atlas/actor/edge/page-cycle reports and the exact 13-section completion journal from the validated ledger.
Publish full Tailnet links and retrievable artifact manifests, update root handover/MOCs/planning projections and show admitted state only after R02.
Record final Jujutsu change/commit/operation/bookmark provenance without Git mutations; retain old evidence/certificates as historical and describe any scoped exclusions explicitly.
tasks.acceptance_gate: All delivered reports and media resolve, the complete evidence chain is inspectable, and completion state exactly matches the admitted candidate.

tasks.title: Register and verify this sa-plan execution programme
implementation_steps: Validate all task IDs, dependencies, requirements and review mappings before a write.
Register tasks, reserved jobs and workflows through Sa_plan.Store in one transaction; replay without duplicates.
Read every registered record back, compare the contract, and complete only this planning task after registration checks pass.
tasks.acceptance_gate: Identical replay preserves records; unknown dependency, cycle and changed payload fail; no implementation job is dispatched.

tasks.title: Implement dependency-gated sa-plan job dispatch and fenced completion
implementation_steps: Dispatch only from a named plan and queue with a current task lease, candidate-bound authorization, and satisfied local and external evidence dependencies.
Use stable task/job/activity IDs and attempt fencing; reject stale completion and prevent effects before task claim.
Enforce a 1200-second command budget, cancellation and process-tree cleanup; retry only declared idempotent work and record each result in sa-plan.
tasks.acceptance_gate: Negative controls cover job/task mismatch, missing external receipt, stale lease, replay, worker crash and timeout; a satisfied-dependency positive control produces one observed effect.

tasks.title: Make sa-plan CLI status and workflow views explicitly plan-aware

Expose actual task dependencies, job arguments and workflow state through typed read-only Store views and the bounded Store adapter.
Reject unknown plan IDs and malformed requests with nonzero process exit; bind output to the selected database and plan.
tasks.acceptance_gate: Two independently populated plans remain isolated in all status projections; no hardcoded-plan fallback.

tasks.title: Replace the simulated OCaml receipt with a real bounded worker
implementation_steps: Define a versioned bounded request/result protocol, real cryptographic payload digest and process identity; obtain typed authorization before dispatch.
Launch and supervise the OCaml worker through a bounded subprocess adapter; collect actual stdout, exit, duration and oracle provenance.
Return nonpassing results for missing worker, malformed frames, timeout, process death and unsupported queries; remove fixed COMMITTED/GOSPEL_VERIFIED receipts.
tasks.acceptance_gate: A positive call proves a real worker PID and independent output; missing/crashed/timed-out workers never return verified receipts.

tasks.title: Implement real journal ingestion and cited corpus retrieval
implementation_steps: Read allowlisted candidate files and parse their real AST/frontmatter/sections; reject absent or malformed journals.
Compute content digests from actual permitted bytes and build a source-revision/dirty-manifest/per-file provenance bundle before corpus admission.
Retrieve citations from the actual admitted index; return locations and matching digests, propagate stale/missing source status and expose true API results.
tasks.acceptance_gate: Different real inputs produce correct distinct metadata and digests; no dry-run count becomes ingestion credit; citations resolve to admitted original content.

tasks.title: Run independent Rust and OCaml knowledge conformance oracles
implementation_steps: Invoke independently pinned native and OCaml implementations with the same versioned fixture, collecting actual outputs and hashes.
Compare normalized semantic outputs without sharing expected values or copying one implementation's digest into the other.
Inject a deliberate one-side mismatch and missing-oracle control; report mismatch/unavailable with no parity credit.
tasks.acceptance_gate: Positive independent execution matches and one-side mutants fail; fixed shared-digest implementations cannot satisfy the gate.

tasks.title: Remove the two observed compiler warnings and record the actual result
implementation_steps: Remove the unused type import and use or remove the redundant inventory binding while preserving assertions.
Run the affected tests and required compiler checks with captured diagnostics; record the exact current warning count.
Correct downstream handover warning claims only using the resulting candidate-bound receipt.
tasks.acceptance_gate: Actual compiler output contains neither targeted warning; no implementation-mirroring test is added for this low-impact cleanup.

tasks.title: Make all storage-safety assertions exercise the production admission path
implementation_steps: Route protected-serial, missing-serial and valid-secondary-device fixtures through the production validator, moving the tested module boundary only if necessary.
Remove the duplicate test-local validator as an oracle; preserve the immutable protected serial in production.
Prove a production-check mutant is detected in an isolated non-destructive fixture; never exercise a real disk wipe.
tasks.acceptance_gate: Safety fixtures call production code; deleting the production rejection causes the suite to fail.

tasks.title: Diagnose and restore the advertised VM-1 HTTP endpoint
implementation_steps: Distinguish name resolution, Tailnet reachability, listener state, service ownership and application health using bounded read-only probes.
Fix the identified service configuration through its owner and authorized service controls, or correct an obsolete advertised endpoint with provenance.
Capture a response carrying actual service/build identity, check linked navigation, and test unavailable-state reporting; do not equate TCP reachability with system health.
tasks.acceptance_gate: The advertised endpoint responds correctly with service identity or an evidence-backed corrected URL; failure remains visible in UI and sa-plan.

dynamic_expansion.policy: Register discovered standards clauses, source cases, routes, components and states as new sa-plan child tasks/jobs before execution; retain parent acceptance as open until the finite pinned census is covered. Graph revision changes use a reviewed extension plan and explicit dependency receipts, never silent replacement of a registered graph.

task_execution_protocol: Read source contract and candidate; classify current evidence
Claim task and job with current ownership; evaluate local and linked-plan dependencies
Record actual failing regression or bounded acceptance baseline
Implement the smallest independently reviewable change in an isolated JJ workspace
Review candidate-bound observations independently; missing tools and unknown results are nonpassing
Record receipt and journal activity, then complete job/task only when its acceptance gate is satisfied
limitations: Planning registration is not implementation admission
Native job claims do not enforce task dependencies; P01 supplies the required dispatch gate
Default CLI status/tree target a legacy plan; use explicit task list and this plan's readback tool
Legacy plan remains in its original store and is linked, not copied
No external agents, services or deployment are started by registration
